flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key containing agreement issues. Only issues in this project are sent to Yousign.

flowVariables.name: YOUSIGN_BASE_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Yousign API host for the target account or environment.

flowVariables.name: YOUSIGN_CREATE_SIGNATURE_PATH
flowVariables.instruction: Yousign API path that creates and sends a signature request from a template. Adjust the request body and response id JSONPath if your endpoint differs.
